schema: golden-path runs. area ids: levels.txt order. wp_area = the waypoint area to teleport/ travel from. stops: ordered area ids to reach (use waypoint then Teleport/path). kill: unique ids/names. loot_tier minimum to pick up. min_clvl per difficulty n/nm/h. Immunity/ danger rules apply.
area_ids_tag: R recollection of levels.txt Id column; engineers MUST verify against levels.txt at setup

runs.name: Countess
runs.note: Tower Cellar L1->L5; Countess rune drops (El..Ral normal, higher in Hell)

runs.name: Andariel
runs.note: Poison: carry antidotes (Normal)/ be wary, bring antidote potions

runs.name: Summoner
runs.note: Arcane Sanctuary; use Teleport; map is a maze of platforms

runs.name: Mephisto
runs.note: Durance 2 wp; moat trick optional; high Mana burn risk from minions

runs.name: Pindleskin
runs.note: Harrogath: Anya's Red Portal (needs Nihlathak quest... open by Anya's scroll quest, Act 5 'Prison of Ice' reward: portal to Nihlathak's Temple). Pindleskin stands beside the portal arrival in area 121. Kill, loot, leave. Do not enter Halls of Anguish (122).

runs.name: Eldritch+Shenk
runs.note: R: Eldritch and Shenk are superuniques; resolve their area from superuniques.txt at runtime. Typical route: WP Frigid Highlands(111)/Bloody Foothills(110). Do not hard-code positions.

runs.name: Cows
runs.note: Requires Wirt's Leg (Tristram, area 38, cairn stones) + Tome of Town Portal in the Horadric Cube in Rogue Encampment; red portal leads to Moo Moo Farm (39). Kill Cow King only after the player requests it (stops further cow portal in that difficulty).

runs.name: Baal
runs.note: Throne waves first; Wave 3 and 5 fastest; cold immune waves require Might merc

runs.name: Diablo
runs.note: Seals order per Chaos Sanctuary layout; Lord de Seis may spawn Cold immune: use Static Field/merc or reroll the game.

runs.name: Travincal
runs.note: Stay at range; Hell: use Static Field, skip if cursed councillors
